scope: One canonical lightweight researcher acquisition/load path for assyrian-royal-inscriptions, with clean standalone disk/startup/RAM measurements and no central builder checkout.

research.finding: Pinned Text-Fabric 13.1 standalone app works after uninstalling the ORACC-TF builder. Keep all TF features in the distribution, but exclude measured audit/duplicate/provenance fields from the advanced-app default preload. The release ZIP plus local app: path is the canonical 1.0 consumer route; Agora remains post-1.0.

design.canonical_route: Versioned standalone release ZIP with checksum; extract and load its local app/ with pinned text-fabric==13.1.0.
design.local_fallback: Use the same extracted distribution directly from an absolute local app: path.
constraints: Do not remove excluded features from TF data; Text-Fabric users may load them explicitly on demand.
Keep document_key and source_id in the normal preload because qualified/source identity is a core research contract.
Keep form, utf8, cf, gw, sense, pos, lang, translation_text, navigation/section features, and synthetic in the normal preload.
The standalone README must replace the placeholder and document the pinned Text-Fabric runtime plus Python/browser local app path without requiring the builder checkout.
Full manual assembly remains owned by #81; release publication/checksum remains owned by #23.

tdd.contract: Add focused tests for the generated default exclusion set and standalone README user path before production changes.
